Common DIY Pitfalls

1. High risk of electrical shorts when bypassing safety sensors manually.

5. Using low-quality spare parts that increase monthly electricity consumption.
6. Structural cracks in AC mountings causing excessive noise and vibration.
7. Missing subtle gas leaks that cause the system to fail within weeks.
